claims.claim_text: After a deep discharge the batteries can take most of a working day to get back on float, and the battery alarm usually stays until they do, so give it more time first. Measure the string voltage now and again in two hours, and if it isn't rising, suspect a weak string and order new batteries; if it is rising, leave it be and the alarm should clear by itself.
claims.symptom: battery alarm not clearing after mains returns following a mains break
claims.check_step: Measure the string voltage now and again in two hours
claims.action: Give it more time for the batteries to get back on float
